page.title: Smart Turrets
page.t: Turrets must turn this fast to keep up with fighters crossing at close range.
Slower projectiles miss manoeuvring fighters. Beams always count as fast enough.
The explosion makes up for aiming errors, so turrets with area damage may turn more slowly.
Roles of all turrets with the current thresholds. Hover over a turret for its stats. Missile turrets are assigned by size, and turrets that support neither mode are not listed.
